title: How the Cleaning-Fee Ceiling of a Roamhaven Listings Listing Is Calculated
content:
# The Cleaning-Fee Ceiling of a Listing

*Pricing team rate note, Roamhaven Listings.*

**Clause.** A listing's regular cleaning fee may be no higher than its cleaning-fee ceiling, and a cleaning fee standing above that ceiling is reset to the ceiling exactly, the reset being logged as one change of the cleaning fee; a cleaning fee at or below the ceiling is left as it stands, and the reset leaves the short-stay cleaning fee as it stands.

**The ceiling.** The cleaning-fee ceiling of a listing is the cleaning-fee maximum of the listing's space type, in US dollars to the cent, rounded half up to the cent at the final step only.

## Inputs

- The listing's space type, from the listing record.
- The space type's cleaning-fee maximum, the per-stay cleaning-fee figure of that space type.
- The regular cleaning fee standing on the listing, from the listing record.

## Worked example (hypothetical figures)

Suppose a space type whose cleaning-fee maximum were $400.00.

| Regular cleaning fee on the listing | Cleaning-fee ceiling | Result |
|---|---|---|
| $425.00 | $400.00 | reset to $400.00; one change of the cleaning fee, $425.00 to $400.00, is logged |
| $400.00 | $400.00 | left as it stands |
| $260.00 | $400.00 | left as it stands |

In each case the listing's short-stay cleaning fee is untouched.
